items.docs: Returns the user's balance in each coin supported by Celsius.

params.name: coin
params.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, USDC. See getSupportedCurrencies.

items.docs: Returns the user's balance in a specific coin and its value in USD.

info.name: Get accrued interest for all coins

items.docs: Returns the user's accrued interest in each coin and its value in USD, plus the total amount accrued in USD across all coins.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to retrieve. Defaults to the first page.

params.name: per_page
params.description: How many records are shown per page. Defaults to 20 records.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of all the user's transactions, sorted by the `time` property in descending order.

info.name: Get all transactions for a coin

params.name: coin
params.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, USDC. See getSupportedCurrencies.

params.name: page
params.description: Page to retrieve. Defaults to the first page.

params.name: per_page
params.description: How many records are shown per page. Defaults to 20 records.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of all the user's transactions for the specified coin, sorted by the `time` property in descending order.

params.name: transaction
params.description: Transaction id in the Celsius system.

items.docs: Returns the state and blockchain hash for the supplied Celsius transaction id.

params.name: coin
params.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, USDC. See getSupportedCurrencies.

items.docs: Returns the deposit address for the specified coin. When `coin` is BTC the `address` is the segwit deposit address and `addressSecondary` carries the legacy address.

params.name: coin
params.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, USDC. See getSupportedCurrencies.

items.docs: Withdraws the requested amount of the specified coin to the supplied address. The address must satisfy the partner's withdrawal scheme (no address / list of pre-approved addresses / any address).

info.name: Get the withdrawal address for a coin

params.name: coin
params.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, USDC. See getSupportedCurrencies.

items.docs: Returns the pre-approved withdrawal address configured for the user for the specified coin.
Returns every pre-approved withdrawal address configured for the user, keyed by coin.
